text:
maya: deploy-bot flagged a canary p95 latency drift in EU (+~30%). Auto-rollback armed but we have a big dedicated customer on that slice. holding auto-revert — need manual decision. :eyes:

deploy-bot: CANARY ALERT: p95 latency 320ms (+32% vs baseline). Auto-rollback scheduled in 5m unless acknowledged. Details: `metric: latency.p95`, `slice: eu-prod-canary`.

leo: Acked. Hold auto-rollback. do not revert entire rollout. proposal: pin rollout at 25% traffic, spin up fallback pool and run targeted partial rollback on model-agent. @ops-runner are you available?

amina: Support+CS looped in, messaging to the customer going out in 10m. @support-lead please draft a non-technical heads-up.

jordan: The release introduced a kv-cache kernel flag change and a small concurrency tweak. We have a cherry-pickable rollback patch ready (patch-id: 2026-04-45). ETA ~12m to prep PR.

ops-runner: Starting rollback playbook step 1: capture logs and snapshots, isolate canary slice. Plan is partial rollback of agent to v2.9.1 on canary hosts only. Command I'll run: `deployctl promote --slice eu-prod-canary --version v2.9.1 --preserve-schema`

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback suspended by manual hold (user: leo). Auto actions paused.

maya: Decision: manual partial rollback of model agent on eu-prod-canary. 2IC: amina. Keep rest of rollout paused.

amina: On it — creating incident bridge and adding notes to the release thread. @support-lead please prepare the customer-facing line: short + reassuring. :thumbsup:

support-lead: Draft sent to legal: "We're pausing the recent rollout while we investigate a latency change affecting the EU region. No data or configs were changed for your account. We'll update you within 30 minutes with next steps."

leo: Ops, execute rollback to v2.9.1 and keep canary traffic at 25% until metrics stabilise. Jordan — confirm patch id.

jordan: Confirmed patch 2026-04-45. I'll open PR and link the changelog. Also adding a short note to release notes under Known Issues.

ops-runner: Rolling back canary now. `deployctl promote` started — rolling back hosts in parallel (5 hosts). 1/5 hosts rolled back. Monitoring telemetry. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Promote job started: promote_job_id=prom-4945-01, targets=5, progress=20%

ops-runner: Rollback complete for all canary hosts. Observing metrics for 10m baseline window now. No error spike on rollback.

maya: Good. Keep canary at 0% new rollout (effectively paused) for 15m, then if stable we can resume a slow ramp. Notify customers + update release notes with the rollback reason and next steps.

support-lead: Customer notified. They asked for a post-mortem; scheduling a 1hr review tomorrow (EMEA friendly).

jordan: PR opened: #8723 cherry-pick patch 2026-04-45 -> main. Will include short remediation steps for ops and a note for docs.

amina: Closing the bridge for now — monitoring in background. We'll reconvene if p95 regresses or any new signals appear. Bridge closed at +40m.

maya: Thanks team. Great coordination. We'll capture a short runbook update for this partial-rollback flow so next time we don't need manual hold for big customers. :white_check_mark:
